observations: The1997 deterministic and probabilistic routines require equal-degree factors; four normalized helper/probabilistic arithmetic bodies match the later endpoint.
The tandem composition difference initializes the scalar field modulus through another API; under the existing modulus equality check both refer to the same field. No native equivalence is asserted.
Later caller removes fixed roots for the two-fixed-root Elkies case, uses a known multiple of the splitting degree, and handles all-fixed/one-fixed cases separately.
Later constructors default to DONT_COMPUTE_SP_DEGREE, with Atkin bound50 if enabled. These are later defaults, not original NIST invocations.
Probabilistic routine draws a polynomial and a separate random projection; the ideal-uniform bound is derived in PROBABILITY-BOUND.md, not assigned to the historical stream.
The low-level deterministic linear-input path reaches an empty factor list without an explicit guard; LINEAR-EDGE.md records static invalid-index flow, not a reproduced native crash.
